$schema: 20 chapters, 4 acts. ids are kebab-case; zone = primary zone from bible §4.

acts.title: The First Body
acts.cliffhanger: Salvi's murder was not a single contract killing. It was a clean-up operation after a much larger discovery.

acts.title: The City of Lies
acts.cliffhanger: A police source has been feeding the conspiracy information about raids and witnesses.

acts.title: Beyond the City
acts.cliffhanger: The conspiracy is not only protecting land deals. It is protecting the people who knew about the contamination before the first resident was displaced.

chapters.title: The Body at Backbay
chapters.mood: Rain, concrete dust, police tape, distant traffic
chapters.shared: Vikram Salvi found dead in an unfinished tower. Crime scene cleaned but not carefully; phone missing, CCTV overwritten, night supervisor vanished.
chapters.reveal: A damaged audio file contains three words: 'Retibandar. Pegs. Leela.'

chapters.title: Paper Trails
chapters.mood: Old paper, xerox heat, crowded footpaths
chapters.shared: The victim had collected survey records and notarised copies. Several residents received contradictory land notices.
chapters.reveal: The notices use different letterheads but share the same hidden print and payment chain.

chapters.title: Eleven After Eleven
chapters.mood: Night traffic, a shuttered newsroom, sodium lamps
chapters.shared: Reconnects to the established Meridian Times, Veer Pawar, the survey truck and the fake pegs.
chapters.reveal: The same vehicle appears near three separate land disputes. Someone is coordinating the pegs.

chapters.title: The Harbour Doesn't Sleep
chapters.mood: Diesel, wet rope, crane lights, black water
chapters.shared: The harbour is not controlled by one gang; it is a negotiated system of favours, access and fear. Bai Firoz becomes central (Meera route).

chapters.title: The Match Fix
chapters.shared: KB's betting network connects the courier routes, harbour payments and local fixers. Arjun, Meera and KB become essential sources.

chapters.title: The Harbour War
chapters.shared: A moving survey truck is intercepted. A jetty is attacked. A witness changes their statement.

chapters.title: Platform Six
chapters.shared: A witness disappears into commuter traffic. A freight movement reveals the first complete harbour ledger.

chapters.title: The Western Ledger
chapters.shared: The investigation reaches corporate offices and redeveloped mill land. Money moves through legitimate-looking contractors.

chapters.title: The Burning Press
chapters.shared: Leela's shop is burned. KB's sister's transplant fund is frozen. Kavya must decide whether to publish incomplete evidence.

chapters.title: The Other Side of the City
chapters.shared: The official case is withdrawn or reassigned. The four protagonists now operate with different levels of institutional cover.

chapters.title: The Stay Order
chapters.shared: A court order temporarily stops the creek work. The press leak exposes a witness's identity.

chapters.title: Thane: The Invisible Border
chapters.shared: A contractor's payment records connect the industrial estate to the contamination. A witness in Mumbra knows who moved the drums. First physical sample secured.

chapters.title: The Last Train to Kalyan
chapters.shared: A railway contractor has been falsifying movement logs. A chase moves through station approaches, service roads and a crowded platform; commuter crowds must not become disposable obstacles.

chapters.title: The Dombivli Files
chapters.shared: A worker death was filed as an accident. The plant's shift logs and chemical storage records do not match the official report.

chapters.title: The Harbour Beyond
chapters.shared: The Navi Mumbai contracts reveal the hidden police coordinator and the network's final container movement.

chapters.title: Internal Affairs
chapters.shared: The player is investigated. The senior officer admits to redirecting operations but claims it prevented a larger collapse.

chapters.title: The Family Man
chapters.shared: Aarav's family, Naina and Kavya are exposed to pressure. Arjun: Veer and family obligations. Meera: the Koli community and younger relatives. The player cannot protect everyone.

chapters.title: Dead Drop
chapters.shared: Three simultaneous tasks: water, road and cash courier. The selected protagonist leads from their own skill set; weak relationships can fail a route.

chapters.title: The City on Record
chapters.shared: The final sting targets the fixer and payment ledger. Putta's fate depends on how the player treated Arjun, witnesses and the local network.

chapters.title: Bambai
chapters.shared: The final operation is about evidence, witnesses and who gets protected. Not simply a final shootout.
